notes.title: Easy Mode Play Broadcast - Clearing Blade
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome to our Easy Mode Play Broadcast! Today, we will be playing with the goal of clearing the first stage!

In this session, we will showcase the game's key features and mechanics, sharing strategies and tips to successfully complete the stage. We encourage you to join in and participate by asking questions or sharing your thoughts in the chat.

Your feedback is invaluable in helping us improve the game. We look forward to an exciting session, so please stay tuned and get involved! Thank you for being part of our community!
